name: cd-on-exit
criterio: Mathias, 2026-10-14: quitting leaves the shell in the folder lazyfinder ends in. The function of --shell-init runs the real binary in bash: it starts in proj, opens alpha and quits; the shell is then in proj/alpha. The shell function calls the program as lazyfinder, so the scenario links ${LAZYFINDER_BIN} under that name in a folder of its own: it does not depend on how the binary is named
cmd: bin_dir="$(mktemp -d)" && ln -s "${LAZYFINDER_BIN}" "$bin_dir/lazyfinder" || { echo "SETUP_FAILED: cannot link ${LAZYFINDER_BIN} as lazyfinder"; sleep 3; exit 1; }; export PATH="$bin_dir:$PATH"; cd "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj" && eval "$(command lazyfinder --shell-init bash)" && lazyfinder; echo "SHELL_IS_IN ${PWD#"${TUIQA_HOME}"/}"; rm -f "$bin_dir/lazyfinder"; rmdir "$bin_dir"; sleep 3

steps.desc: the shell is in the folder lazyfinder ended in
